motion.registerRationale: PRODUCT.md Brand Personality is brand-register with a cinematic/aspirational formal voice introducing an entity; arrival is the heuristic default for a brand-register marketing surface introducing an entity (and the tiebreak default when editorial also matches). The captured signature — generative-particle-hero + scrollytelling-reveal + enormous hero headline + 'Motion as narrative' principle — maps one-to-one onto arrival's signature moves (hero parallax, rising plate, staggered per-section entrances, hero-text enterUp stagger). No --cinematic-register override supplied.
motion.refusesClauseResolution: arrival refuses editorial-airy section padding (>96px desktop). Dala's captured 120px sections do NOT carry forward — the multi-audience density floor caps sectionPadding.desktop at 64px in C, so the refuses clause is satisfied and the editorial/arrival tiebreak is moot.
motion.reducedMotion: Every motion element (hero parallax, rising plates, per-section entrances, constellation-divider resolves, footer-wordmark wipe) is neutralised to a static resolved end-state under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. The reduced-motion render is a complete, legible page on its own.

structuralDeltasVsA: Live-particle hero composition: the hero is a live generative particle field with scroll-parallax + enterUp-staggered headline, vs A's static hero paired with a concrete product-moment panel — different hero composition / layout strategy.

Constellation-divider system: each section transition is a constellation field that resolves into a diamond node as the next section rises and staggers in (arrival choreography), vs A's plain section breaks — a structural section-divider system that does not exist in A.

Footer-wordmark constellation wipe: the footer 'Dala' wordmark is composed of constellation points converging into the letterforms on reveal, vs A's static wordmark footer — a distinct footer treatment / signature component.

narrative.overview: Variant C amplifies the captured generative-particle constellation — the literal product thesis — into the brand's structural voice. On the captured site it appears once at the hero, then is abandoned; C threads it from the first viewport through every section divider and resolves it in the footer wordmark. Typography, scale and IA are inherited from variant A verbatim; the differentiation is motion (register arrival), not layout.

rules.name: The Constellation-Spine Rule
rules.body: The generative constellation threads hero → section dividers → footer wordmark as one structural system; it is never a one-off hero backdrop.

rules.name: The Reduced-Motion-Complete Rule
rules.body: Every motion element resolves to a static legible end-state under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. The reduced-motion render is a complete page on its own.

dos: Do thread the constellation from hero to section dividers to footer wordmark as one structural system.
Do keep IA identical to A; the differentiation is motion, not layout.
Do gate every motion element behind prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't define C as 'B but more', size-as-personality, or padding-as-personality.
Don't spread the accent purple into the constellation as decoration.
Don't let motion break the single 'Request Access' funnel or move the hero out of the first viewport.
